ayahs.arabicText: طٰهٰۚ
ayahs.translation: Ta' Ha'

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ لِتَشْقٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: We did not reveal the Qur'an to you to cause you distress;

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَنْ یَّخْشٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: it is only a reminder for him who fears Allah;

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ وَ السَّمٰوٰتِ الْعُلٰىؕ
ayahs.translation: a revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلرَّحْمٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰى
ayahs.translation: The Most Compassionate Lord is settled on the Throne (of the Universe).

ayahs.arabicText: لَهٗ مَا فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ مَا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا وَ مَا تَحْتَ الثَّرٰى
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and all that is in between, and all that is beneath the soil.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَاِنَّهٗ یَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَ اَخْفٰى
ayahs.translation: Whether you speak out aloud (or in a low voice), He knows what is said secretly, and even that which is most hidden.

ayahs.arabicText: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ لَهُ الْاَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنٰى
ayahs.translation: Allah - there is no god but He. His are the most excellent names.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِیْثُ مُوْسٰىۘ
ayahs.translation: Has the story of Moses reached you?

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْۤا اِنِّیْۤ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى
ayahs.translation: When he saw a fire and said to his family: "Hold on! I have just perceived a fire; perhaps I will bring a brand from it for you, or I will find some guidance at the fire about the way to follow."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اَتٰىهَا نُوْدِیَ یٰمُوْسٰىؕ
ayahs.translation: When he came to it, a voice called out: "Moses!

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْۤ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَیْكَ١ۚ اِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًىؕ
ayahs.translation: Verily I am your Lord! Take off your shoes. You are in the sacred valley, Tuwa!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا یُوْحٰى
ayahs.translation: I Myself have chosen you; therefore, give ear to what is revealed.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّنِیْۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِیْ١ۙ وَ اَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: Verily I am Allah. There is no god beside Me. So serve Me and establish Prayers to remember Me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِیَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخْفِیْهَا لِتُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: The Hour of Resurrection is coming. I have willed to keep the time of its coming hidden so that everyone may be recompensed in accordance with his effort.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا یَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَنْ لَّا یُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرْدٰى
ayahs.translation: Let him who does not believe in it and follows his lust not turn your thought away from it, lest you are ruined.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تِلْكَ بِیَمِیْنِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: And what is in your right hand, O Moses?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هِیَ عَصَایَ١ۚ اَتَوَكَّؤُا عَلَیْهَا وَ اَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰى غَنَمِیْ وَ لِیَ فِیْهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخْرٰى
ayahs.translation: Moses answered: "This is my staff. I lean on it (when I walk), and with it I beat down leaves for my flock, and I have many other uses for it."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَلْقِهَا یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "Moses, throw it down."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَلْقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِیَ حَیَّةٌ تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: So he threw it down, and lo! it was a rapidly moving snake.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَ لَا تَخَفْ١ٙ سَنُعِیْدُهَا سِیْرَتَهَا الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: Then He said: "Seize it and have no fear. We shall restore it to its former state.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اضْمُمْ یَدَكَ اِلٰى جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَیْضَآءَ مِنْ غَیْرِ سُوْٓءٍ اٰیَةً اُخْرٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: And place your hand in your armpit, it will come forth shining white, without blemish. This is another Sign of Allah,

ayahs.arabicText: لِنُرِیَكَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِنَا الْكُبْرٰىۚ
ayahs.translation: for We shall show you some of Our greatest Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبْ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And go to Pharaoh now for he has transgressed all bounds."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "Lord! Open my breast for me;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: and ease my task for me,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ احْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: and loosen the knot from my tongue

ayahs.arabicText: یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۪
ayahs.translation: so that they may understand my speech;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اجْعَلْ لِّیْ وَزِیْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: and appoint for me, from my household, someone who will help me bear my burden -

ayahs.arabicText: هٰرُوْنَ اَخِیۙ
ayahs.translation: Aaron, my brother.

ayahs.arabicText: اشْدُدْ بِهٖۤ اَزْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: Strengthen me through him

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَشْرِكْهُ فِیْۤ اَمْرِیْۙ
ayahs.translation: and let him share my task

ayahs.arabicText: كَیْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِیْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: that we may abundantly extol Your glory;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَذْكُرَكَ كَثِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: and may remember You much.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ كُنْتَ بِنَا بَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Verily, You have always watched over us."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ قَدْ اُوْتِیْتَ سُؤْلَكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "Moses, your petition is granted.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَیْكَ مَرَّةً اُخْرٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: We have again bestowed Our favour upon you.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰۤى اُمِّكَ مَا یُوْحٰۤىۙ
ayahs.translation: Recall, when We indicated to your mother through inspiration:

ayahs.arabicText: اَنِ اقْذِفِیْهِ فِی التَّابُوْتِ فَاقْذِفِیْهِ فِی الْیَمِّ فَلْیُلْقِهِ الْیَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ یَاْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّیْ وَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهٗ١ؕ وَ اَلْقَیْتُ عَلَیْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّیْ١ۚ۬ وَ لِتُصْنَعَ عَلٰى عَیْنِیْۘ
ayahs.translation: 'Put the baby into a chest and then throw him in the river. The river will throw him up on the shore, and then an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will take him.' And I spread My love over you in order that you might be reared in My sight.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ تَمْشِیْۤ اُخْتُكَ فَتَقُوْلُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلٰى مَنْ یَّكْفُلُهٗ١ؕ فَرَجَعْنٰكَ اِلٰۤى اُمِّكَ كَیْ تَقَرَّ عَیْنُهَا وَ لَا تَحْزَنَ١ؕ۬ وَ قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّیْنٰكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَ فَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوْنًا١۫۬ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِیْنَ فِیْۤ اَهْلِ مَدْیَنَ١ۙ۬ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلٰى قَدَرٍ یّٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: Recall, when your sister went along, saying: 'Shall I direct you to one who will take charge of him?' Thus We brought you back to your mother so that her heart might be gladdened and she might not grieve. Moses, recall when you slew a person. We delivered you from distress and made you go through several trials. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian, and now you have come at the right moment as ordained.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِیْۚ
ayahs.translation: I have chosen you for My service.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبْ اَنْتَ وَ اَخُوْكَ بِاٰیٰتِیْ وَ لَا تَنِیَا فِیْ ذِكْرِیْۚ
ayahs.translation: So go forth, both you and your brother, with My Signs, and do not slacken in remembering Me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْهَبَاۤ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰىۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Go both of you to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed all bounds,

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُوْلَا لَهٗ قَوْلًا لَّیِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ یَتَذَكَّرُ اَوْ یَخْشٰى
ayahs.translation: and speak to him gently, perhaps he may take heed or fear (Allah)."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَا رَبَّنَاۤ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنْ یَّفْرُطَ عَلَیْنَاۤ اَوْ اَنْ یَّطْغٰى
ayahs.translation: The two said:" Lord! We fear he may commit excesses against us, or transgress all bounds."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَاۤ اِنَّنِیْ مَعَكُمَاۤ اَسْمَعُ وَ اَرٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "Have no fear. I am with you, hearing and seeing all.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاْتِیٰهُ فَقُوْلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوْلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ١ۙ۬ وَ لَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ١ؕ قَدْ جِئْنٰكَ بِاٰیَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ١ؕ وَ السَّلٰمُ عَلٰى مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدٰى
ayahs.translation: So, go to him, and say: 'Behold, both of us are the Messengers of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not chastise them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord; and peace shall be for him who follows the true guidance.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا قَدْ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیْنَاۤ اَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلٰى مَنْ كَذَّبَ وَ تَوَلّٰى
ayahs.translation: It has been revealed to us that chastisement awaits those who called the lie to the truth and turned away from it.' "

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَنْ رَّبُّكُمَا یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said:" Moses! Who is the Lord of the two of you?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِیْۤ اَعْطٰى كُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلْقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "Our Lord is He Who gave everything its form and then guided it."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُوْنِ الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh asked: "Then, what is the state of the former generations?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّیْ فِیْ كِتٰبٍ١ۚ لَا یَضِلُّ رَبِّیْ وَ لَا یَنْسَى٘
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "Its knowledge is with my Lord, recorded in the Book. My Lord does not err, nor does He forget."

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّ سَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا سُبُلًا وَّ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً١ؕ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰى
ayahs.translation: He it is Who spread the earth for you; and made in it paths for you, and sent down water from the sky, and then through it We brought forth many species of diverse plants.

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُوْا وَ ارْعَوْا اَنْعَامَكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّاُولِی النُّهٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So eat yourself and pasture your cattle. Surely there are many Signs in this for people of understanding.

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ وَ فِیْهَا نُعِیْدُكُمْ وَ مِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً اُخْرٰى
ayahs.translation: From this very earth We created you and to the same earth We shall cause you to return, and from it We shall bring you forth to life again.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرَیْنٰهُ اٰیٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَ اَبٰى
ayahs.translation: Indeed We showed Pharaoh Our Signs, all of them, but he declared them to be false and rejected them.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ اَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land by your sorcery?

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَنَاْتِیَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهٖ فَاجْعَلْ بَیْنَنَا وَ بَیْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهٗ نَحْنُ وَ لَاۤ اَنْتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
ayahs.translation: We shall confront you with a sorcery like your own. So appoint a day when both of us might meet face to face in an open space; an appointment which neither we nor you shall fail to keep."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ یَوْمُ الزِّیْنَةِ وَ اَنْ یُّحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "The appointment to meet you is on the Day of the Feast and let all people come together before noon."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَوَلّٰى فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَیْدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰى
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh went back and concerted all his stratagem and returned for the encounter.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰى وَیْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَیُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذَابٍ١ۚ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرٰى
ayahs.translation: (At the time of the encounter) Moses said to them: "Woe to you! Do not invent falsehoods against Allah lest He destroy you with a scourge. Surely those who invent lies shall come to grief."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَنَازَعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ وَ اَسَرُّوا النَّجْوٰى
ayahs.translation: Thereupon they wrangled among themselves about the matter and conferred in secret.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذٰىنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ یُرِیْدٰنِ اَنْ یُّخْرِجٰكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَ یَذْهَبَا بِطَرِیْقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلٰى
ayahs.translation: Some of them said: "These two are magicians, who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and to destroy your excellent way of life.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَجْمِعُوْا كَیْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُوْا صَفًّا١ۚ وَ قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْیَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلٰى
ayahs.translation: So muster all your stratagem and come forth in a row. Whoever prevails today shall triumph."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰمُوْسٰۤى اِمَّاۤ اَنْ تُلْقِیَ وَ اِمَّاۤ اَنْ نَّكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ مَنْ اَلْقٰى
ayahs.translation: The magicians said: "Moses, will you throw down or shall we be the first to throw?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ اَلْقُوْا١ۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَ عِصِیُّهُمْ یُخَیَّلُ اِلَیْهِ مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ اَنَّهَا تَسْعٰى
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: "No, let it be you to throw first." Then suddenly it appeared to Moses, owing to their magic, as if their ropes and staffs were running.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْجَسَ فِیْ نَفْسِهٖ خِیْفَةً مُّوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: So Moses' heart was filled with fear.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْاَعْلٰى
ayahs.translation: We said to him: "Have no fear; for it is you who will prevail.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَلْقِ مَا فِیْ یَمِیْنِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوْا١ؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوْا كَیْدُ سٰحِرٍ١ؕ وَ لَا یُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَیْثُ اَتٰى
ayahs.translation: And throw down what is in your right hand; it will swallow up all that they have wrought. They have wrought only a magician's stratagem. A magician cannot come to any good, come whence he may."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاُلْقِیَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوْنَ وَ مُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: Eventually the magicians were impelled to fall down prostrate and said: "We believe in the Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِیْرُكُمُ الَّذِیْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ١ۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَیْدِیَكُمْ وَ اَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّ لَاُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِیْ جُذُوْعِ النَّخْلِ١٘ وَ لَتَعْلَمُنَّ اَیُّنَاۤ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "What! Did you believe in Him even before I permitted you to do so? Surely, he must be your chief who taught you magic. Now I will certainly cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and will crucify you on the trunks of palm-trees, and then you will come to know which of us can inflict sterner and more lasting torment."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَنْ نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلٰى مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ الْبَیِّنٰتِ وَ الَّذِیْ فَطَرَنَا فَاقْضِ مَاۤ اَنْتَ قَاضٍ١ؕ اِنَّمَا تَقْضِیْ هٰذِهِ الْحَیٰوةَ الدُّنْیَاؕ
ayahs.translation: The magicians answered: "By Him Who has created us, we shall never prefer you to the Truth after manifest Signs have come to us. So decree whatever you will. Your decree will pertain, at the most, to the present life of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِیَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰیٰنَا وَ مَاۤ اَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَیْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: We believe in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and also forgive us the practice of magic to which you had compelled us. Allah is the Best and He alone will abide."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ مَنْ یَّاْتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجْرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَ١ؕ لَا یَمُوْتُ فِیْهَا وَ لَا یَحْیٰى
ayahs.translation: The truth is that Hell awaits him who comes to his Lord laden with sin; he shall neither die in it nor live.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّاْتِهٖ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الْعُلٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: But he who comes to Him with faith and righteous works shall be exalted to high ranks,

ayahs.arabicText: جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ؕ وَ ذٰلِكَ جَزٰٓؤُا مَنْ تَزَكّٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and shall live for ever in everlasting Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Such will be the reward of those who purify themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى١ۙ۬ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِیْ فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِیْقًا فِی الْبَحْرِ یَبَسًا١ۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّ لَا تَخْشٰى
ayahs.translation: Most certainly We revealed to Moses: "Proceed with My servants in the night and strike for them a dry path in the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be afraid of treading through the sea."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُوْدِهٖ فَغَشِیَهُمْ مِّنَ الْیَمِّ مَا غَشِیَهُمْؕ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh pursued them with his hosts, but they were fully overwhelmed by the sea.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهٗ وَ مَا هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh led his people astray; he did not guide them aright.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰبَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ قَدْ اَنْجَیْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَ وٰعَدْنٰكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّوْرِ الْاَیْمَنَ وَ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَیْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَ السَّلْوٰى
ayahs.translation: Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy and made a covenant with you on the right side of the Mount and sent down on you manna and quails,

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُوْا مِنْ طَیِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ وَ لَا تَطْغَوْا فِیْهِ فَیَحِلَّ عَلَیْكُمْ غَضَبِیْ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّحْلِلْ عَلَیْهِ غَضَبِیْ فَقَدْ هَوٰى
ayahs.translation: saying: "Partake of the good things that We have provided for you, but do not transgress lest My wrath fall upon you; for he upon whom My wrath falls is ruined.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدٰى
ayahs.translation: But I am indeed Most Forgiving to him who repents and believes and does righteous works and keeps to the Right Way."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَعْجَلَكَ عَنْ قَوْمِكَ یٰمُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: "But, O Moses, what has made you come in haste from your people?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هُمْ اُولَآءِ عَلٰۤى اَثَرِیْ وَ عَجِلْتُ اِلَیْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضٰى
ayahs.translation: He said: "They are close behind me, and I hastened to You, Lord, that You may be pleased with me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِكَ وَ اَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِیُّ
ayahs.translation: Said He: "Verily We tested your people in your absence and the Samiri led them astray."

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَجَعَ مُوْسٰۤى اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ غَضْبَانَ اَسِفًا١ۚ۬ قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اَلَمْ یَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا١ؕ۬ اَفَطَالَ عَلَیْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ اَمْ اَرَدْتُّمْ اَنْ یَّحِلَّ عَلَیْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُمْ مَّوْعِدِیْ
ayahs.translation: Moses returned to his people full of wrath and grief, and said: "My people! Has your Lord not made good an excellent promise He made to you? And has a long time passed since those promises were fulfilled? Or was it to incur the wrath of your Lord that you broke your promise with me?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا مَاۤ اَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَ لٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَاۤ اَوْزَارًا مِّنْ زِیْنَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلْقَى السَّامِرِیُّۙ
ayahs.translation: They answered: "We did not break our promise with you out of our own volition; but we were laden with the load of people's ornaments, and we simply threw them down(into the fire), and the Samiri also threw down something,

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوْا هٰذَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمْ وَ اِلٰهُ مُوْسٰى١۬ فَنَسِیَؕ
ayahs.translation: and brought out of there (from the molten gold) the effigy of a calf that lowed." The people cried out: "This is your deity and the deity of Moses, whom Moses has forgotten."

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَا یَرَوْنَ اَلَّا یَرْجِعُ اِلَیْهِمْ قَوْلًا١ۙ۬ وَّ لَا یَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا نَفْعًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Did they not see that it did not return a word to them, and had no power either to hurt them or to cause them any benefit?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هٰرُوْنُ مِنْ قَبْلُ یٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهٖ١ۚ وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِیْ وَ اَطِیْعُوْۤا اَمْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: Certainly Aaron had said to them even before (the return of Moses): "My people, you were fallen into error because of the calf. Surely your Lord is Most Compassionate; so follow me and obey my command."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَنْ نَّبْرَحَ عَلَیْهِ عٰكِفِیْنَ حَتّٰى یَرْجِعَ اِلَیْنَا مُوْسٰى
ayahs.translation: But they answered: "By no means shall we cease to worship it until Moses returns to us."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰهٰرُوْنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذْ رَاَیْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوْۤاۙ
ayahs.translation: (After rebuking his people) Moses turned to Aaron and said: "Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ١ؕ اَفَعَصَیْتَ اَمْرِیْ
ayahs.translation: from following my way? Have you disobeyed my command?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَاْخُذْ بِلِحْیَتِیْ وَ لَا بِرَاْسِیْ١ۚ اِنِّیْ خَشِیْتُ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ فَرَّقْتَ بَیْنَ بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ وَ لَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِیْ
ayahs.translation: Aaron answered: "Son of my mother! Do not seize me with my beard, nor by (the hair of) my head. I feared that on returning you might say: 'You sowed discord among the Children of Israel, and did not pay heed to my words.'"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ یٰسَامِرِیُّ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "What, then, is your case, O Samiri?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ یَبْصُرُوْا بِهٖ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوْلِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَ كَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِیْ نَفْسِیْ
ayahs.translation: He answered: "I saw what the people did not see. So I took a handful of dust from the trail of the Messenger, and I flung it (into the fire). Thus did my mind prompt me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ لَا مِسَاسَ١۪ وَ اِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّنْ تُخْلَفَهٗ١ۚ وَ انْظُرْ اِلٰۤى اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِیْ ظَلْتَ عَلَیْهِ عَاكِفًا١ؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنْسِفَنَّهٗ فِی الْیَمِّ نَسْفًا
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "Be gone, then. All your life you shall cry: 'Untouchable.' There awaits a term for your reckoning that you cannot fail to keep. Now look at your god that you devotedly adored: We shall burn it and scatter its remains in the sea.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: Your God is none else than Allah, beside Whom there is no god. His knowledge embraces everything."

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَیْكَ مِنْ اَنْۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ١ۚ وَ قَدْ اٰتَیْنٰكَ مِنْ لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًاۖۚ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), thus do We recount to you the events of the past, and We have bestowed upon you from Ourself an admonition.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَاِنَّهٗ یَحْمِلُ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ وِزْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: He who turns away from it will surely bear a heavy burden on the Day of Resurrection,

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ سَآءَ لَهُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ حِمْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and will abide under this burden for ever. Grievous shall be the burden on the Day of Resurrection,

ayahs.arabicText: یَّوْمَ یُنْفَخُ فِی الصُّوْرِ وَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ یَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: the Day when the Trumpet shall be sounded and We shall muster the sinners, their eyes turned blue with terror.

ayahs.arabicText: یَّتَخَافَتُوْنَ بَیْنَهُمْ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا عَشْرًا
ayahs.translation: They shall whisper among themselves: "You stayed on the earth barely ten days."

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ اِذْ یَقُوْلُ اَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِیْقَةً اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا یَوْمًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We know well what they will say to one another: We also know that even the most cautious in his estimate will say: "You lived in the world no more than a day."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَسْئَلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ یَنْسِفُهَا رَبِّیْ نَسْفًاۙ
ayahs.translation: They ask you concerning the mountains: "Where will they go?" Say: "My Lord will scatter them like dust,

ayahs.arabicText: فَیَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and leave the earth a levelled plain

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا تَرٰى فِیْهَا عِوَجًا وَّ لَاۤ اَمْتًاؕ
ayahs.translation: in which you shall find no crookedness or curvature.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَئِذٍ یَّتَّبِعُوْنَ الدَّاعِیَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗ١ۚ وَ خَشَعَتِ الْاَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ اِلَّا هَمْسًا
ayahs.translation: On that Day people shall follow straight on to the call of the summoner, no one daring to show any haughtiness. Their voices shall be hushed before the Most Compassionate Lord, so that you will hear nothing but a whispering murmur.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَ رَضِیَ لَهٗ قَوْلًا
ayahs.translation: On that Day intercession shall not avail save of him whom the Most Compassionate Lord permits, and whose word of intercession is pleasing to Him.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَ لَا یُحِیْطُوْنَ بِهٖ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: He knows all that is ahead of them and all that is behind them, while the others do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَنَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ لِلْحَیِّ الْقَیُّوْمِ١ؕ وَ قَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
ayahs.translation: All faces shall be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Lord, and he who bears the burden of iniquity will have failed;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا یَخٰفُ ظُلْمًا وَّ لَا هَضْمًا
ayahs.translation: but whosoever does righteous works, being a believer, shall have no fear of suffering wrong or loss."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا وَّ صَرَّفْنَا فِیْهِ مِنَ الْوَعِیْدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَتَّقُوْنَ اَوْ یُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), thus have We revealed this as an Arabic Qur'an and have expounded in it warning in diverse ways so that they may avoid evil or become heedful.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ١ۚ وَ لَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یُّقْضٰۤى اِلَیْكَ وَحْیُهٗ١٘ وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ زِدْنِیْ عِلْمًا
ayahs.translation: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Hasten not with reciting the Qur'an before its revelation to you is finished, and pray: "Lord! Increase me in knowledge."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ عَهِدْنَاۤ اِلٰۤى اٰدَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَسِیَ وَ لَمْ نَجِدْ لَهٗ عَزْمًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Most certainly We had given Adam a command before, but he forgot. We found him lacking in firmness of resolution.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْۤا اِلَّاۤ اِبْلِیْسَ١ؕ اَبٰى
ayahs.translation: Recall when We said to the angels: "Prostrate yourselves before Adam"; all prostrated themselves save Iblis. He refused.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا یٰۤاٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَ لِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا یُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقٰى
ayahs.translation: Then We said: "Adam! He is an enemy to you and to your wife. So let him not drive both of you out of Paradise and plunge you into affliction,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوْعَ فِیْهَا وَ لَا تَعْرٰىۙ
ayahs.translation: (for in Paradise) neither are you hungry nor naked,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا فِیْهَا وَ لَا تَضْحٰى
ayahs.translation: nor face thirst or scorching heat."

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَسْوَسَ اِلَیْهِ الشَّیْطٰنُ قَالَ یٰۤاٰدَمُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰى شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَ مُلْكٍ لَّا یَبْلٰى
ayahs.translation: But Satan seduced him, saying: "Adam! Shall I direct you to a tree of eternal life and an abiding kingdom?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْاٰتُهُمَا وَ طَفِقَا یَخْصِفٰنِ عَلَیْهِمَا مِنْ وَّرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ١٘ وَ عَصٰۤى اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰى۪ۖ
ayahs.translation: Then the two of them ate the fruit of that tree and their shameful parts became revealed to each other, and they began to cover themselves with the leaves from the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord and strayed into error.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اجْتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَیْهِ وَ هَدٰى
ayahs.translation: Thereafter his Lord exalted him, accepted his repentance, and bestowed guidance upon him,

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِیْعًۢا بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ١ۚ فَاِمَّا یَاْتِیَنَّكُمْ مِّنِّیْ هُدًى١ۙ۬ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَایَ فَلَا یَضِلُّ وَ لَا یَشْقٰى
ayahs.translation: and said: "Get down, both of you, (that is, man and Satan), and be out of it; each of you shall be an enemy to the other. Henceforth if there comes to you a guidance from Me, then whosoever follows My guidance shall neither go astray nor suffer misery.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِیْ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِیْشَةً ضَنْكًا وَّ نَحْشُرُهٗ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ اَعْمٰى
ayahs.translation: But whosoever turns away from this Admonition from Me shall have a straitened life; We shall raise him blind on the Day of Resurrection,"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِیْۤ اَعْمٰى وَ قَدْ كُنْتُ بَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: where-upon he will say: "Lord! Why have You raised me blind when I had sight in the world?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتْكَ اٰیٰتُنَا فَنَسِیْتَهَا١ۚ وَ كَذٰلِكَ الْیَوْمَ تُنْسٰى
ayahs.translation: He will say: "Even so it is. Our Signs came to you and you ignored them. So shall you be ignored this Day."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِیْ مَنْ اَسْرَفَ وَ لَمْ یُؤْمِنْۢ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ وَ لَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: Thus do We requite him who transgresses and does not believe in the signs of your Lord (during the life of the world); and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is even more terrible and more enduring.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ یَمْشُوْنَ فِیْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ لِّاُولِی النُّهٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Did they not find any guidance in the fact that We destroyed many nations in whose ruined dwelling-places they now walk about? Surely there are many Signs in them for people endowed with wisdom.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّ اَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّىؕ
ayahs.translation: Were it not for a word already gone from your Lord, the decree (of their destruction) would have come to pass.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰى مَا یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَ قَبْلَ غُرُوْبِهَا١ۚ وَ مِنْ اٰنَآئِ الَّیْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَ اَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضٰى
ayahs.translation: So bear patiently with what they say. Glorify your Lord, praising Him before sunrise and before sunset, and in the watches of the night, and glorify Him and at the ends of the day that you may attain to happiness.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَیْنَیْكَ اِلٰى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖۤ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۙ۬ لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ رِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى
ayahs.translation: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the embellishments of worldly life that We have bestowed upon various kinds of people to test them. But the clean provision bestowed upon you by your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَ اصْطَبِرْ عَلَیْهَا١ؕ لَا نَسْئَلُكَ رِزْقًا١ؕ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ١ؕ وَ الْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوٰى
ayahs.translation: Enjoin Prayer on your household, and do keep observing it. We do not ask you for any worldly provision; rather, it is We Who provide you, and ultimately the pious will end up the best.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ لَا یَاْتِیْنَا بِاٰیَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ تَاْتِهِمْ بَیِّنَةُ مَا فِی الصُّحُفِ الْاُوْلٰى
ayahs.translation: They ask: "Why does he not bring us a (miraculous) sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them a Book containing the teachings of the previous scriptures?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ اَنَّاۤ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَیْنَا رَسُوْلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰیٰتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَّذِلَّ وَ نَخْزٰى
ayahs.translation: Had We destroyed them through some calamity before his coming, they would have said: "Our Lord! Why did You not send any Messenger to us that we might have followed Your signs before being humbled and disgraced?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا١ۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَصْحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِیِّ وَ مَنِ اهْتَدٰى۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Muhammad): "Everyone is waiting for his end. Wait, then, and you will soon know who are the people of the Right Way, and are rightly-guided."
